comment: Free downloaded models for power buildings (docs/design/building-draw.md "Downloaded models with a moving part"). 'prep' is read by tools/fab_prep.py (Blender: the files in assets/raw/fab/, downloaded once from Fab, not in Git -> assets/raw/power/<Name>/). 'buildings' is read by the GunArt commandlet (-List=assets/power_art.json): each FBX becomes one combined mesh, /Game/Rim3D/Generated/Buildings/<name>/SM_<name>, which the def's visual.mesh (and visual.rotor.mesh) names. Sizes are ours, fitted to RimWorld's footprints (wind turbine 5 x 2, solar generator 4 x 4).
